indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_alerts_open_sensor_type ON public.alerts USING btree (sensor_id, type) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'ACKNOWLEDGED'::text])) AND (sensor_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_alerts_open_device_type ON public.alerts USING btree (device_id, type) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['OPEN'::text, 'ACKNOWLEDGED'::text])) AND (sensor_id IS NULL) AND (device_id IS NOT NULL))
